newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NGC Corp cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NGC Corp cut to hold.

text.p: Jefferies & Co analyst Lawrence Crowley cut his rating on NGC Corp to hold from buy based on unexpected weakness in the market for natural gas liquids (NGL) products.

-- In a statement, the analyst said he cut his second quarter earnings estimate to $0.15 a share from $0.22, and his third quarter estimate to $0.25 from $0.31. His full-year 1997 estimate was cut to $0.80 a share from $0.95.
-- said the company's current difficulties stem from the previous winter's NGL inventory and hedging problems.
-- said cost allocation issues will not be fully resolved until the fourth quarter, and he has concerns about possibile further problems.
